# Installation and environment checks

## Create a Conda environment

```bash
conda create -n iobrpy -y
conda activate iobrpy
conda install -y -c conda-forge -c bioconda iobrpy
```

## Verify the installation

```bash
iobrpy --help
```

## Create the project directory

Use the same project root throughout the tutorial:

```bash
export IOBRPY_DEMO=/analysis/IOBRpy_PRJNA1161405_demo

mkdir -p \
  "$IOBRPY_DEMO/input/fastq" \
  "$IOBRPY_DEMO/reference" \
  "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_salmon" \
  "$IOBRPY_DEMO/results_star"
```
